dglab.status.help: DG-LAB · /dglab share on shares readings with this server. /dglab connect pairs locally, /dglab status shows readings, /dglab disconnect ends the connection. /dglab feedback configures the damage HUD.
dglab.status.hud_help: /dglab hud on|off, /dglab hud max on|off, /dglab hud position left|right.
dglab.status.no_address: No usable private IPv4 address. Enter /dglab connect followed by this PC’s LAN IPv4 address.
dglab.status.bind_failed: Cannot listen on that address or port. Check the local adapter address, or omit the port to select a free one.
dglab.status.scan: Scan the top-left code with the DG-LAB 3.x app on the same LAN. Expires in 3 minutes. Address %s.
dglab.status.title: App readings · A/B
dglab.status.paired: DG-LAB paired. Waiting for the first reading.
dglab.status.expired: Pairing code expired. Use /dglab connect for a new code.
dglab.status.temporary: Preference applied for this session. Could not save to disk.
dglab.status.share_on: Sharing enabled for this session. Once paired, you and the server operators can query your current A/B readings and limits. Use /dglab share off to stop.
dglab.status.share_off: Server sharing stopped. The local HUD is still available.
dglab.status.share_active: Readings are shared for this game connection.
dglab.status.share_inactive: Local display only. Use /dglab share on to share readings with this server.
dglab.status.server_missing: This server does not advertise DG-LAB status sync. Install the updated server mod and restart. Local /dglab connect is still available.
dglab.server.help: DG-LAB server integration is active. Use /dglabserver status to see your server-side status.
dglab.server.console: Use dglabserver list or dglabserver status <player> in the console.
dglab.server.empty: No players are sharing DG-LAB readings.
dglab.server.private: %s is not sharing readings with this server.
dglab.server.waiting: %s is paired and awaiting the app’s first reading.
dglab.feedback.title: Damage HUD
dglab.feedback.unknown_source: Unknown damage type in this world: %s
dglab.feedback.unknown_wave: Unknown HUD preset: %s. Use /dglab feedback waves.
dglab.feedback.settings: Damage HUD %s · base %s · hit step %s · return %s/s · wave %s · default sources %s
dglab.feedback.help: /dglab feedback: sources all|none; source <id> on|off|step|wave|reset; base, step, decay, waves, wave, preview, status.
dglab.feedback.temporary: Damage HUD settings applied for this session. Could not save.
dglab.feedback.waves: %s HUD presets (click a name to fill in the command): %s
